0022600237.text: The Lakers (10-2, first in the Pacific and West, on a six-game winning streak) visit the Suns (4-6, 11th in the West, 5 games back in third place in the Pacific) for their 14th game of the season. Quentin Grimes is out for Los Angeles with a finger injury, and Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery. The two teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers lost 2-3 to the Suns in the 2025-26 season series, but Los Angeles won the last meeting 101-73 in Los Angeles on April 10, 2026.
